body:
Thanks for the report! Consolidating in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/71929.

In the meantime, try switching the `rendering_driver.windows` project setting to `d3d12`.

Hi!

I have a few questions for you:

1. Regarding OBS:
    1. Did you open OBS after it froze and then recorded that video?
    2. Or was OBS open before it froze?
    3. Does this happen even with OBS closed?
2. Could you download [VulkanCapsViewer](https://vulkan.gpuinfo.org/download.php) and post a picture of the Instance -> Layer section? It looks like this:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/50d71c52-03e9-4585-9534-39f77a764fc3)
3. What language and region is your system? e.g. English + US (en_US), English + UK (en_UK), Spanish + Mexico (es_MX), etc.
4. Can you upload OBS logs? In OBS, go to `Help -> Log Files -> View Current Log`. OBS lets you see older logs. If in them you see "BindImageMemory", "failed to AllocateMemory", or "failed to CreateImage" I'd like to see those logs too.
5. Does the problem persist if you launch Godot with the following cmd prompt:
```batch
set VK_LOADER_LAYERS_DISABLE=~all~
godot.exe
```

This is a weird bug. vkQueueSubmit is not complaining, which is why you're able to see the output in OBS. But vkQueuePresentKHR is failing, which is why you can't see it.

However that's not how device lost is supposed to work. If one fails, the other should too. This reeks of an implicit layer causing a problem.

> Thanks for the report! Consolidating in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/71929.

I'm not sure about that. That ticket merely says "something went wrong" and is incredibly noisy with all different causes. This ticket is providing specific information that I would like to follow up, at least for now.

I've had this problem as well but in my case the editor actually is "responsive" however it's registering clicks in the wrong place. It appears unresponsive when my clicks go to padding/whitespace which of course has no effect. Sometimes the clicks do land on a clickable element which is some distance away from where my cursor is actually located. 
For me this problem goes away if I minimize the window and un-minimize it.
